data_fields.name: ramp start and end time (per clip)
data_fields.donor_constant: no donor default; set by caller

best_idea: Layer a hero's motion as a few weighted clip slots, each with a speed and an eased start and end ramp, and blend the active slots per bone as a normalised running mean with a full mask table per move.
decision_why: The hero needs layered clips (a locomotion or guard base plus an arm-only attack on a mask, ramped in and out); this slot, ramp and normalised-mean shape fits, but Frankendom must use bone-index masks from the catalogue, full mask tables (the donor keeps stale channel weights), and one time unit, and keep it client-only.
acceptance: A unit test on src/fight/anim-mixer.ts checks that the blended pose equals the weighted mean of the active slot samples per channel, and that after an arm-mask switch from attack to guard no channel keeps the attack weight; in play the arm eases from guard into attack over the catalogue ramp time while the legs keep the locomotion clip.
